_meta.notes: T56 first slice: one authored region of real 3D terrain - a rock arch with an underside and an overhang, generated from a signed-distance field and meshed by surface nets. Covers the region only; planet-wide chunks, streaming, root tunneling and the Root Sight cavity are later slices. The T25 height field remains the surface truth underneath.

enabled.notes: Draw the authored volume region. Off leaves the world exactly as it was: one heightfield skin.

centre_x_m.notes: Centre of the authored region, in the same pole-local metres the terrain field uses. Chosen for 1.3 m of ground relief across the arch's footprint (the first site had 2.8 m and buried its uphill leg) and a base that stands clear of every crest between it and spawn.

centre_z_m.notes: Centre of the authored region, across the play area.

voxel_size_m.notes: Grid step the signed-distance field is sampled on. Smaller finds finer rock and costs more samples; 0.28 m keeps the arch's 1.05 m band four cells thick.

margin_m.notes: Air sampled round the solid on every side. Surface nets needs a closed ring of outside samples or the mesh ends open at the grid boundary.

leg_depth_m.notes: How far below the drawn ground the arch's legs continue before they are cut off. The first visual pass at 1.4 m left the cut face standing proud of the falling ground on a crest; 2.6 m keeps it under the soil from every side the player can reach.

seed.notes: Deterministic variation of the rock's thickness and its strata, so the same region is the same rock on every machine.

span_m.notes: Width of the arch's opening, measured between the two feet at ground level.

rise_m.notes: Height of the arch's crown above its footing.

thickness_m.notes: Thickness of the rock band at its base, tapering to 72% of this at the crown. It is real thickness: the underside is a surface of its own.

width_m.notes: Depth of the arch across its span at its base, narrowing to 78% at the crown - how wide the rock bridge is to walk under.

bearing_deg.notes: Direction the span runs, in degrees from +x towards +z. Chosen so the opening faces the spawn plant.

strata_band_m.notes: Vertical spacing of the rock's beds. Each vertex's bed fraction is the material the mesher carries into the renderer.
